item.title: Signature Drink 1: Blue Slam Dunk
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: "🏀 Blue Slam Dunk is a vibrant blue cocktail that’s as bold as your favorite team’s winning shot. Served in a tall glass, this refreshing drink features a citrusy blend of vodka, blue curaçao, and lemonade, garnished with a lemon slice and a sports-themed stirrer. Perfect for game nights or celebrating a victory with friends!"

item.title: Signature Drink 2: Red Zone Rush
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: 🏈 Red Zone Rush is a striking red cocktail that packs a flavorful punch. Served in a short glass, this fan-favorite drink combines rum, grenadine, and a splash of lime juice, topped with a cherry and a sports-themed umbrella. It’s the ultimate drink to keep your spirits high during the big game!"

item.title: Waiter / Waitress
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.content:encoded:
Bright Bistro is hiring Waiters & Waitresses!
Join our energetic team and help us deliver amazing dining experiences. Responsibilities include:

  • Taking orders and serving food & drinks
  • Providing friendly, attentive service
  • Assisting in cleaning and table setup

Requirements:

  • Great communication skills
  • Positive attitude

Jazz, R&B & Gourmet Plates in Spartanburg

Step into the heart of Spartanburg’s nightlife! McClellan’s Fish & Chicken brings you live jazz, soul, and R&B in a warm, upscale setting. Enjoy chef-crafted plates, candlelit cabanas, and a vibrant outdoor stage where the community comes together every week. Whether it’s First Fridays or R&B Fridays, experience unforgettable music, food, and company.

item.title: StrikeZone Bowling Center
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: StrikeZone Bowling Center, located in Columbia, SC, is a premier entertainment venue offering a modern bowling experience with a touch of excitement. Known for its lively Cosmic Bowling Nights and competitive League Nights, StrikeZone caters to families, friends, and bowling enthusiasts alike. The center also features a full-service snack bar, a vibrant arcade, and customizable birthday party packages, making it a top choice for celebrations and fun-filled outings. item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Elijah “Wordsmith” Reed is a seasoned spoken word artist and storyteller based in Columbia, SC. With 8 years of experience, Elijah’s poetry delves into themes of identity, culture, and social justice. Known for his powerful voice and thought-provoking performances, Elijah has graced stages at poetry festivals, community events, and private gatherings. His words leave a lasting impact on audiences, sparking meaningful conversations.

item.title: Nina “Trendsetter” Blake - Stylist Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Nina “Trendsetter” Blake is a creative wardrobe stylist based in Columbia, SC, with 5 years of experience in fashion consulting and personal shopping. Known for her bold and trendsetting approach, Nina specializes in creating unique looks for photoshoots, red carpet events, and everyday style makeovers. Her ability to mix textures, colors, and patterns allows clients to stand out and express their individuality.

item.title: Brianna “Elegance Expert” Monroe - Stylist Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Brianna “Elegance Expert” Monroe is a seasoned stylist based in Charleston, SC, with 8 years of experience specializing in wardrobe styling for upscale events and fashion consulting. Known for her sophisticated and timeless approach, Brianna creates elegant and polished looks for weddings, galas, and corporate events. Her ability to curate stunning ensembles makes her a trusted stylist for clients looking to leave a lasting impression.

item.title: Ava “Style Maven” Carter - Stylist Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Ava “Style Maven” Carter is a talented stylist based in Charleston, SC, with 7 years of experience in hairstyling and wardrobe consulting. Known for her creative flair and attention to detail, Ava specializes in creating stunning looks for weddings, photoshoots, and special events. Her ability to blend classic and modern styles makes her a go-to stylist for clients seeking a personalized and polished appearance.

item.title: Jordan “The Glam Guru” Ellis - Stylist Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Jordan “The Glam Guru” Ellis is a versatile stylist based in Greenville, SC, with 6 years of experience in hairstyling and makeup artistry. Known for creating glamorous looks for weddings, photoshoots, and special events, Jordan combines creativity and precision to enhance each client’s natural beauty. With a reputation for professionalism and attention to detail, Jordan is a trusted choice for clients seeking a polished and radiant appearance.

item.title: Jordan “Lens Master” Taylor - Photographer Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Jordan “Lens Master” Taylor is a talented photographer based in Charleston, SC, with 5 years of experience specializing in event and portrait photography. Known for a vibrant and modern style, Jordan captures the energy and emotion of every moment. From weddings to corporate events, Jordan’s work reflects creativity and professionalism, making every shot stand out.

item.title: Malik “Frame King” Carter - Videographer Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Malik “Frame King” Carter is a skilled videographer based in Columbia, SC, with 7 years of experience capturing visually stunning and emotionally impactful videos. Specializing in event coverage, music videos, and creative storytelling, Malik is known for his dynamic style and ability to bring any vision to life. His work has been featured in music collaborations, corporate campaigns, and special events across South Carolina.

item.title: Chris “Visionary” Johnson - Videographer Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Chris “Visionary” Johnson is a creative videographer based in Columbia, SC, with 6 years of experience capturing stunning visuals for events, promotional content, and creative projects. Known for his cinematic style and attention to detail, Chris transforms moments into timeless videos. His expertise includes weddings, corporate events, and artist collaborations.

item.title: Maya “Soul Writer” Thompson - Poet Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Maya “Soul Writer” Thompson is a passionate spoken word artist based in Charleston, SC. With 6 years of experience, Maya’s poetry explores themes of love, resilience, and empowerment. Known for her captivating performances and rhythmic flow, Maya has performed at local poetry slams, community events, and private gatherings. Her work inspires and connects audiences on a deep, emotional level.

item.title: Taylor “CinePro” West - Videographer Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Taylor “CinePro” West is a seasoned videographer based in Charleston, SC, with 8 years of experience specializing in cinematic visuals and high-quality editing. Taylor’s expertise lies in creating impactful promotional videos, wedding films, and artistic collaborations. Known for a keen eye for detail and storytelling, Taylor ensures every project is visually stunning and emotionally engaging.

item.title: Purr & Play Café Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Purr & Play Café in Charleston, SC, is a cozy space for cat lovers to relax and unwind. The café features a dedicated cat lounge where patrons can interact with adoptable cats while enjoying locally sourced coffee and treats. Purr & Play Café works with animal shelters to find forever homes for its feline residents and hosts regular adoption events.

item.title: Dboy Stackalini - Rap/Producer/Song Writer Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Dboy Stackalini is an emerging hip-hop artist from Goldsboro, NC, known for his raw lyrics and high-energy performances. Drawing inspiration from his life experiences and the streets of Goldsboro, Dboy’s music resonates with fans who appreciate authenticity and passion. With several singles gaining traction on streaming platforms, he’s quickly becoming a name to watch in the rap scene.

item.title: The Gamer's Arena Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: The Gamer's Arena is Columbia’s ultimate destination for competitive and casual gaming. Designed with state-of-the-art equipment and a welcoming atmosphere, this venue provides a space for gamers of all levels to connect, compete, and celebrate their passion for gaming. With weekly tournaments, private gaming lounges, and professional-grade streaming setups, The Gamer's Arena is the go-to spot for gaming enthusiasts in South Carolina.

item.title: The Maker’s Nook Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: The Maker’s Nook in Greenville, SC, is a haven for DIY lovers. Specializing in home décor and seasonal crafts, the studio offers a variety of classes and events, from wreath-making to custom wood signs. The Maker’s Nook also hosts private crafting parties for birthdays and team-building events.

item.title: The Artisan’s Haven Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: The Artisan’s Haven is Charleston’s leading art gallery, celebrating fine art and cultural heritage. Featuring a curated collection of paintings, sculptures, and mixed media, the gallery highlights the work of talented artists from South Carolina and beyond. The Artisan’s Haven also hosts cultural art events, offering a platform for local artists to shine and connect with the community.

Based in Spartanburg, SC, Alex specializes in custom cocktail creation, flair bartending, and providing exceptional customer service. Certified in mixology and bar management, Alex is known for adding a touch of flair to every event.

item.excerpt:encoded: Liam “Craft King” Thompson is a skilled craft bartender and beverage consultant based in Greenville, SC, with 6 years of experience creating unique and innovative drinks. Known for his expertise in craft cocktails and local ingredients, Liam specializes in creating memorable experiences for guests through his creative drink presentations and exceptional service. Certified in mixology and beverage consulting, Liam is a go-to for upscale events and private parties.

item.excerpt:encoded: Maria “Guardian” Lopez is a highly skilled security professional based in Charleston, SC, with 6 years of experience in private security and VIP protection. Known for her attention to detail and proactive approach, Maria has worked with high-profile clients and managed security for large-scale events. Certified in advanced surveillance techniques and conflict resolution, she ensures the safety and comfort of all her clients.

item.title: Anthony “Steel” Johnson - Security Personnel Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: Anthony “Steel” Johnson is a veteran security professional with over a decade of experience in event security and team management. Based in Greenville, SC, Anthony specializes in high-capacity events, team coordination, and VIP protection. Known for his leadership skills and calm demeanor under pressure, Anthony ensures every event runs smoothly and safely. He is certified in advanced crowd management and emergency response.

item.title: James “Shield” Carter - Security Personnel Profile
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: James “Shield” Carter is a seasoned security professional with over 8 years of experience in event and venue safety. item.excerpt:encoded: Alyssa “Luxe” Martinez is a high-fashion model and content creator based in Columbia, SC. With her elegant style and creative vision, Alyssa has worked with local designers and photographers to bring bold concepts to life. She’s passionate about empowering women to embrace confidence and individuality through fashion and beauty.

item.excerpt:encoded: Burgar is Spartanburg’s go-to destination for bold flavors and vibrant vibes. Located in the heart of downtown, Burgar reinvents the classic burger experience with a Latin twist—think savory patties topped with fresh salsas, unique spices, and zesty sauces. The atmosphere is lively, welcoming, and perfect for foodies, families, and anyone looking to spice up their meal. Whether you’re craving a gourmet burger, signature sides, or a handcrafted cocktail, Burgar delivers a fusion of cultures on every plate. Joinus for live events, happy hours, and a taste of something truly different at Burgar—where burgers meet Latin flair!

item.title: D.Petty
item.dc:creator: Kenneth
item.excerpt:encoded: D.Petty is a soulful R&B artist from Spartanburg, South Carolina, known for his chill, laid-back presence and smooth, emotionally-driven sound. With a voice that reflects both softness and strength, D.Petty creates music that speaks where words fall short — tapping into the quiet corners of emotion and the unspoken truths of life.

D.Petty is a soulful R&B artist from Spartanburg, South Carolina, known for his chill, laid-back presence and smooth, emotionally-driven sound. With a voice that reflects both softness and strength, D.Petty creates music that speaks where words fall short — tapping into the quiet corners of emotion and the unspoken truths of life.

Making music seriously for the past five years, he’s carved out a style that feels honest and raw, drawing inspiration from lived experience and the subtle power of unspoken communication. His songs are less about making noise and more about creating connection — whether through vulnerability, vibe, or sheer soul.
